    Documents

    All 49 of the council's source files, grouped as in the Google Drive folder, each with its transcribed text and original file.

    Published by
    Thammasat University Student Council, Tha Prachan (TUSC)
    Last updated
    31 October 2026
    Origin
    The council’s Google Drive folder “OPEN DATA 2025”: 49 files
    Transcribed
    All 49 files as HTML text, 14 of them scans.

    Drive folders

    1. 1. Announcements (16)
    2. 2. List of Student Council members (1)
    3. 3. Regulations and rules (9)
    4. 4. Meeting agendas (3)
    5. 5. Fund information (9)
    6. 6. Minutes of meetings (7)
    7. 7. Ad hoc committee reports (3)
    8. Other (1)

    The folders follow the council’s Drive, so people who know it can find things.
